properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-family hash references declared in both npm lockfiles (sha.js-family implementations and sha512- integrity digests in the ethers/hardhat trees). Hashes are Grover-affected only — no Shor break; shipped crypto surface, no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 npm package (+ @types/secp256k1) declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json — the pure-JS secp256k1 ECDSA library in the hardhat/ganache dev-and-test toolchain. Shor-vulnerable signing primitive; keccak256+secp256k1 are fixed by the Ethereum protocol, so the library is changeable only with the toolchain. No direct application call site — scripts/deploy.js and hardhat use it transitively.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: EVP_BytesToKey (OpenSSL legacy MD5-based KDF) referenced by the browserify crypto shim in the hardhat/ganache dependency tree. Legacy KDF — classically weak (MD5-based), symmetric-only, no Shor exposure; recorded as shipped crypto surface with no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt password-hashing package declared in the hardhat dependency tree (dev/test toolchain). Memory-hard symmetric KDF — not Shor-vulnerable; part of the shipped toolchain surface with no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh (browserify elliptic-curve ECDH) declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json — ganache/hardhat tree, including the nested ganache-core copy — plus an ECDH reference in client/package-lock.json. Shor-vulnerable key agreement in the shipped dependency surface; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 reference declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json (hardhat/ganache toolchain tree). Shor-vulnerable signature scheme (public keys in signed messages enable retroactive forgery); shipped surface, no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA reference in the client lockfile, in the elliptic/ethers dependency tree that implements this dApp's Ethereum transaction signing (secp256k1 ECDSA, Shor-vulnerable). No direct application call site names the algorithm — the signing is reached through the MetaMask/ethers wrapper.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 reference declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json (hardhat/ganache toolchain tree). Shor-vulnerable key agreement (harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to any recorded transcript); shipped surface with no direct application call site. PQ migration for any live use: ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak packages (js-sha3, keccak, keccak256 family) across both lockfiles — keccak256 is Ethereum's own hash, used by ethers/hardhat for addressing, ABI encoding and tx hashing. Grover-affected only; no Shor break.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 (browserify) entries across both lockfiles — used in the ethers/hardhat trees for JSON-keystore key derivation alongside scrypt. HMAC-SHA-based KDF; Grover-affected only, no Shor exposure. No application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt/scrypt-js/scryptsy entries across both lockfiles — ethers v5 uses scrypt as the default KDF for JSON-keystore wallet encryption. Memory-hard symmetric KDF; not Shor-vulnerable. No application call site in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (tweetnacl secretbox) reference declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json — ganache/ethereumjs dev-toolchain tree. Symmetric authenticated encryption; Grover halves effective key strength only, no Shor break. No direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl library declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json — ganache/ethereumjs dev-toolchain tree. Ships NaCl primitives (XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox, Ed25519 signatures, X25519 key agreement); the "." site is the collector rollup pointing at the same lockfile. No direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js package declared in client/package-lock.json — the scrypt implementation ethers v5 ships in this dApp's client bundle for JSON-keystore wallet encryption. Memory-hard symmetric KDF; not Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js package declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json — browserify SHA-1/SHA-2 implementation in the hardhat/ganache tree (source of many sha512- integrity digests). Hashes are Grover-affected only; shipped toolchain surface, no application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context

Quantum-vulnerable (Shor); replaceable only by the ethers/elliptic maintainers or an Ethereum protocol change.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js package declared in client/package-lock.json — hash primitives (SHA/RIPEMD-160) used by elliptic inside the ethers tree for Ethereum address derivation in this dApp's shipped bundle. Grover-affected only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 package declared in smart_contract/package-lock.json — browserify PBKDF2 in the hardhat/ganache dev-toolchain tree. HMAC-SHA-based KDF; Grover-affected only. No application call site.

components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (Node.js version unknown)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live outbound HTTPS session: fetch() to https://api.giphy.com on default TLS settings — harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure. Note the classifier's "Node.js" basis is off: this is a browser-side fetch in a Vite/React SPA, so the TLS stack is the browser's; PQ readiness depends on the runtime negotiating hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 (TLS 1.3). Also: the Giphy API key (VITE_GIPHY_API, inlined into the bundle at build time) travels in the URL query string on this session.
